prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_screen], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] remains mixed: one test won (+7.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.6% after noise correction).
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconclusive: one test was stopped early (-8.4% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (+0.8% after noise correction).
[finish, redesign] changes tend to be helpful, as two tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests across all rounds.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early or showed no clear effect, with round 11 as the sole exception.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +4.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Docking and Visibility Control Center: Rebuild the home intro screen into a split control hub featuring interactive pet desktop visibility toggles and display position settings. (why: Three support tickets reported pets not displaying on the desktop post-setup, and previous finish step redesigns consistently won (+5.5% and +4.3%).)
1: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Crafting Studio Layout: Redesign the photo upload stage into a full-bleed interactive studio layout with dynamic photo positioning guidelines. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (69.7%) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Control and Voice Practice Sequence: Insert a multi-screen interactive practice flow after home intro teaching desktop shortcuts, hiding the pet, and voice commands. (why: Three support emails noted confusion over controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Persistent Pet Sync Sign-In Layout: Update the sign-in layout to split format with clear cloud sync indicators assuring users that pet data persists across sessions. (why: Eight support tickets—the largest issue group—reported pets disappearing or resetting after logging back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Stage Progress Tracker: Display an active rendering progress status timer and informative setup tips while waiting for pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) and median (201s), causing drop-off during background pet asset compilation.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Companion Orientation Showcase Screen: Add a dedicated orientation screen before path selection highlighting everyday desktop pet activities. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path despite taking only a median of 8s, indicating a lack of context on companion capabilities.)
6: [adoption, hint] Pet Selection Compatibility Hints: Add clear helper hints on pet choices detailing rendering requirements and personality traits. (why: Adoption has a 69.7% conversion rate and 3 support complaints regarding poor custom pet generation results.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Active Taskbar Status Banner: Update the home intro text to explicitly state that the app runs minimized in the system tray if no pet appears immediately. (why: Three support tickets reported users being unable to open the app or missing the pet on their desktop after onboarding.)
8: [sign_in, notification] Account Auth Sync Protection Notice: Display a prominent sync confirmation banner on the sign-in screen informing users their pet profile is auto-backed up. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
